provenance.method: Independently authored local driver supplies hand-authored bodies to unchanged upstream MessageRegistry and message decoders, asserts full consumption, then serializes via upstream message encoders with ModInfo.PROTOCOL_VERSION and MessageRegistry.getMessageId. Rust independently checks both decode semantics and encoded equality.
provenance.scope: Serializer oracle only, not a Minecraft loader/client or graphical gate. Trackable fixture instances use allocateInstance to bypass the live-world-only constructor guard; all wire fields are populated by the actual decoder. No upstream source is copied or distributed.
